summary: Nifty +1.85% to 25,819 on a 17th straight session of foreign buying (about ₹1.2 lakh crore in November), a rupee at an 8-month high (92.16/$) and Brent easing to about $88-91. After the close the US proposed a 25% 'excess capacity' tariff on Indian goods (17% if a trade deal is signed); GIFT Nifty fell 0.5% and the Nasdaq dropped 4% on an AI selloff. October CPI was 6.09%, above RBI's band, and economists expect a 25 bp repo-rate hike in December. Q2 GDP (due 30 Nov) is expected near 7.5%.

events.title: US proposes 25% tariff on Indian goods, 17% if a trade deal is signed
events.detail: Proposed under an 'excess capacity' probe covering India and 13 other economies; rates and product lists are not final. Goods exporters to the US are exposed; services (IT) are not covered by goods tariffs; specialty pharma was exempted from the separate 100% drug tariff in September. A deal at 17% would be a relief versus 25%. Impact sized as a hit to export margins for US-heavy exporters, not to domestic demand. Applied only to companies whose business description mentions exports or US customers.
